summary: AGNC Investment Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $2 billion. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. The company entered into sales agreements with multiple agents, including Goldman Sachs and Barclays, for best-efforts sales at market prices. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, restructuring, or other special event. This is a standard equity issuance under an existing shelf registration.
